quests.instruction: TAP FLOATING EMOJIS AND CONSTRUCT A SITUATION DESCRIPTION
quests.situation: [Diver Prompt 161-1] Describe how deep hydrothermal vents release superheated chemical compounds.
quests.hint: Focus on hot springs expelling rich black plumes of sulfide minerals. (Diving calibration index 161-1)
quests.explanation: Vents erupt superheated solutions containing hydrogen sulfide and sulfur particles. [Verified by Creative Cartographer Unit 161].

quests.instruction: TAP FLOATING EMOJIS AND CONSTRUCT A SITUATION DESCRIPTION
quests.situation: [Microbe Prompt 161-2] Describe the survival mechanism of marine bacteria in dark abyssal plains.
quests.hint: Describe how microbes convert chemical energy without any sunlight. (Diving calibration index 161-2)
quests.explanation: Microscopic deep marine bacteria perform chemosynthesis to convert chemicals to sugars. [Verified by Creative Cartographer Unit 161].

quests.situation: [Microbe Prompt 161-3] Describe the photosynthetic layers of giant underwater kelp forests.
